column1: Jeremy Pena leads the slate with a strong hit probability and steady track record at the top of Houston’s lineup, facing a lefty he matches up well against at home. Luis Arraez offers similar reliability, consistently finding hits and drawing a favorable spot in Philadelphia’s order. Ceddanne Rafaela is also in play with a solid home matchup and recent consistency. All three bring dependable profiles, but Pena’s combination of opportunity and matchup stands out.
